subject: Mental Models
title: Kairos vs Chronos
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Kairos vs Chronos.

hook.text: A comedian tells the same joke twice. The first time, the room erupts. The second time, silence.

buildup.text: The Greeks had two words for time. Chronos is sequential clock time.

discovery.text: Kairos thinking means reading the situation for ripeness.

twist.text: Most planners focus on what and how but not when. Timing can matter more than execution.

climax.text: Train yourself to sense kairos moments. When conditions align, strike decisively.

punchline.text: The right move at the wrong time still fails.

quiz.question: What does the Greek concept of kairos represent?
options: The end of a time period
